Like what you See? Join the Team.

Nice to meet you, we're City Hive.

In 2016, a group of data and technology experts asked themselves about a bottle of wine they were enjoying, why isn’t there a better way to buy this? Why has technology left behind the multi-billion beer, wine, and spirits industry?

We’re a company driven by a single question: why accept market inefficiency? Why allow a market to be ignored by the winds of technological change? With that question in mind, we built City Hive, the world’s first all-in-one u-Commerce platform.

Our mission is to democratize access to the tools that make businesses of all sizes profitable. From web and app development to digital marketing and e-Commerce, the City Hive platform takes work that would have been done by 100 people and makes it doable by one.

Take on Challenges.

At City Hive, we see every challenge, struggle, and setback as an opportunity for both personal and professional growth. Whether you’re developing a new feature for our web app, meeting with clients, or running an ad campaign, City Hive knows that every task, no matter how small, is a chance for greatness.

Become a Stakeholder.

City Hive isn’t just a company, it’s your company. With a comprehensive equity package, the company’s success is all of our success, and your work can impact it. We’re working on problems that have a high market demand and generate significant revenue. With you on our team, the future is ours for the taking.

Benefits of City Hive

City Hive offers comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance along with ClassPass memberships and online mental healthcare.

City Hive provides competitive compensation with biannual performance reviews and opportunities for promotions and pay-raises.

At City Hive, we know that your work isn’t your life. That’s why we provide unlimited paid time off and opportunities for generous discounts with our partner retailers.

City Hive knows that the key to successful work life is enjoying your work environment. That’s why City Hive works out of a state-of-the-art startup hub with every resource you need to excel in your work.
